value.headline: NOR edges it
value.summary: Norway (NOR) comes out ahead overall, edging out Verstappen (VER) thanks to faster race pace (86.399 s/lap vs 87.784 s/lap) and better peak pace (84.696 s vs 86.157 s). NOR also beats VER in qualifying by 1.178 places (3.929 places vs 5.107 places) and finishes on average 0.293 places ahead (3.667 places vs 3.96 places). VER is stronger in overtaking (5.107 overtakes vs 4.464) and gains more positions (1.08 places vs 0.167). The comparison is limited by the fact that NOR failed to finish five of the 28 races and VER missed four, which drags down both drivers’ result and pace averages.
caveats: NOR did not finish 5 of these races, which drags their result and pace averages.
VER did not finish 4 of these races, which drags their result and pace averages.
value.rule_summary: NOR leads on race pace, peak pace, tyre management, qualifying, most clearly on race pace (1.385 s/lap). VER answers on positions gained, overtaking. Across 28 races: head-to-head 14-14, level on pace, points 377-391.
